title: new junk in the tree: merge leftovers, stray logs, a binary over 1 MB
how: paths the diff adds (git diff --name-status -M): a name matching patterns, or a binary blob over max_bytes; allow = the legitimate ones (test fixtures)

explain.what: The branch adds junk: a merge left-over (.orig, .rej), a backup (.bak, ~), a log file, or a binary over 1 MB.
explain.why: Junk files are noise in every checkout and clone, and a big binary stays in the git history for good, even after it is deleted.
explain.fix: Delete the file and commit; add its pattern to .gitignore if a tool makes it again. A real test fixture goes under tests/fixtures/.
